model.name: Huihui abliterated Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4
model.artifact_identity_source: same artifact; operator-attested file hash, not HTTP-verified

hardware.clock_limitation: Requested application clocks do not establish constant SM frequency under load; this is one observed snapshot.

protocol.harness_hash_source: preserved same campaign script; absent from original metadata

performance.selection_use: The heldout-labeled performance fixtures were used for MTP tuning; final performance on them is not independent of selection.

performance.verdict_detail: invalid fixed-output trial: early stop or wrong usage

methodology.scope: Public attention Op, not whole-model throughput

numerical_qualification.oracle: Independent FP64 from represented public inputs; reference remains unrounded

broad_fused_gpu_suite.failure: BF16 graph fallback seed974, under original criterion

numerical_qualification.criterion_scope: Causal A1 append, A3 cached and batch, all registered storage profiles
numerical_qualification.coverage_limit: Large-prefill oracles sample first/middle/last queries; all heads, all 256 output components and all visible keys are covered for each selected query. Passing tolerance is not bitwise or model-distribution parity.

selected_profile.rationale: MTP3 long decode is only 1.65% above MTP4; MTP4 is 20.46% above MTP3 at 16K. MTP7 long decode is 21.57 tok/s. A single seed does not establish universal optimality.

limitations: One prompt and one seed-repeat per performance length, no repeated interleaved A/B.
MTP4 intermediate prefill overlapped about 30 seconds of CPU diagnostic compilation; no GPU competition. MTP3/7 had no compilation overlap.
Arithmetic and draft acceptance changed; model decode differences are not pure kernel speedups.
Original candidate metadata labels include qualified, but these are inherited labels, not evidence of model qualification.
MTP4 and MTP3/7 use different binary hashes with the same intended production math and historical T1024 gate. Final broader-gate binary must be measured separately.
Baseline 131K performance ended after 702 output tokens and is excluded from fixed-output comparisons.
Six quality cases are a narrow regression gate; second repeats, perf code templates, general reasoning parity, image quality and full-capacity output are not established.
Public metrics contain selected measurements and verdicts, not raw generated answers or private operational state.

Production prefix reuse is enabled and defaults to medium/8192 thinking; the controlled benchmark disabled prefix reuse and quality explicitly requested xhigh/16384. Smoke results do not replace that controlled comparison.

comparison.limits: Only valid fixed-output pairs support speed comparisons; quality rows compare pass@1. Different cache residency excludes prefill speedup. Small heldout suite is not a reasoning benchmark.

deployment.residency_note: The qualified Qwen installation and production smoke are verified. The GPU was subsequently restored to the prior service; Qwen is currently stopped and not resident.

production_smoke.scope: Two first-turn calculator tool selections and one simple image-color case; not a multi-turn agent or broad vision benchmark.

restoration.scope: Restored service health, readiness and actual GPU residency; no claim that the prior container image is byte-identical after independent service updates.
